CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (Toxic.cs:15) == `exhausts = True`, and NOT Unplayable -- Toxic is a PLAYABLE status whose play exists only to exhaust it before end of turn, and the sim correctly leaves `is_playable` True. The same shape as card/slimed and card/spore_mind.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Status, CardRarity.Status, TargetType.None)` (Toxic.cs:21-24) == cost 1 / STATUS / STATUS / NONE. A REAL cost of 1, not the -1 sentinel, so the ascenders_bane cost finding does not apply.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim inlines 5 at the damage site (toxic.py:157)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new DamageVar(5m, ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move)` (Toxic.cs:17) is a printed var with no `_damage` in `_init_vars`, so `Card.base_damage` returns None. The PROP SET is right: the sim passes no explicit props and `DamageCmd.deal` infers `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` (UNPOWERED | MOVE) from `is_unpowered = True` (cmds.py:44-50, toxic.py:145), so the 5 damage is not Strength-scaled and IS blockable on both sides -- identical to card/burn, card/decay and card/infection. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed number the sim's `magic_number` cannot surface, so `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card without it. DORMANT for game fidelity, LIVE for the observation encoder.

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Damage, this)` (Toxic.cs:28) -- passing the VAR so the props ride along -- == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, 5, dealer=None, card=self)` with the inferred props. Explicit null dealer on both sides. At 5 damage this is the hardest-hitting end-of-turn status in the pool.

OnPlay.rationale: Toxic.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it costs 1 and only exhausts the card. A reachable no-op on both sides.
